name: Mark AI
author: Mark AI

sections.description:
Mark AI is an AI-powered content creation platform that helps marketing teams produce on-brand, high-quality content at scale.

This plugin lets you publish content directly from Mark AI to your WordPress site – manually or automatically through workflows.

Why use this plugin?

  • One-click publishing – Send content from Mark AI to WordPress instantly
  • Template support – Use existing posts as templates for AI-generated content
  • Automated workflows – Schedule and automate publishing with Content Factory
  • Preserved formatting – Your content looks exactly as designed in Mark AI
  • Full WordPress support – Categories, tags, featured images, custom fields
  • Secure connection – Only your account can access your site, API keys are encrypted, and access can be revoked anytime

Getting started is simple:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect from your Mark AI dashboard
  3. Start publishing!

Support

  • Plugin Documentation: WordPress Integration Help Center
  • Support: Available directly in the Mark AI app

External Service

This plugin connects to the Mark AI API service (https://api.markcopy.ai).

IMPORTANT: No external connections are made until you explicitly authorize the plugin. The connection only activates after you:

  1. Navigate to the authorization page from your Mark AI dashboard
  2. Review the permissions and data that will be shared
  3. Click the “Authorize Connection” button

You can revoke this authorization at any time from Settings → Mark AI by clicking “Disconnect from Mark AI”.

Data Transmitted to Mark AI:

When you authorize the connection, the following data is sent once to Mark AI:

  • Site URL and site name (to identify your WordPress site)
  • WordPress version and PHP version (for compatibility checking)
  • Site language (for localization)
  • Plugin version (for feature support)
  • A secure API key (for authenticating requests)

Schema Discovery (on-demand):

After authorization, Mark AI may request information about your site’s content structure:

  • Available post types (e.g., posts, pages, custom post types)
  • Custom fields (postmeta keys, ACF fields, SEO plugin fields)

This helps Mark AI display the correct publishing options in its interface.

Template Analysis (on-demand):

When you select a post as a reference template in Mark AI, the plugin reads:

  • Post metadata (title, type, editor used)
  • Content structure (Elementor widgets or Gutenberg blocks)
  • Editable content slots within the template

This allows Mark AI to generate content that matches your existing page layouts. Template analysis only occurs when you explicitly select a post as a reference.

What is NOT collected:

  • No bulk content export – only posts you explicitly select as templates
  • No user data or personal information
  • No analytics or tracking data

Content flows both ways: Mark AI reads template structure when you select a reference post, and publishes new content when you trigger publishing.

Data Storage and Third Parties:

Your site data is stored securely within your Mark AI account and is used solely to enable the publishing functionality. Mark AI does not share your site data with third parties, does not sell your data, and does not use it for advertising or analytics purposes.

Access Control: Mark AI provides granular role-based permissions for this integration. Workspace administrators can control which team members are allowed to publish content to your WordPress site.

For more information:

  • Mark AI Terms of Service
  • Mark AI Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data from your visitors and does not track activity in your WordPress admin. All API keys and plugin settings are stored locally in your WordPress database. The plugin only communicates with Mark AI’s servers after you explicitly authorize the connection — no data is transmitted before authorization. Your site information is stored in your Mark AI account only and is not shared with third parties. For more information about how Mark AI handles data, please visit https://www.markcopy.ai/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Mark AI Integrations and click the WordPress connector
  2. Click “Connect WordPress” in the popup
  3. You’ll be redirected to your WordPress site – install and activate the plugin if prompted
  4. Click “Authorize” to allow Mark AI to publish content
  5. You’re automatically redirected back to Mark AI – your site is now connected
sections.faq:
Is this plugin secure?

Yes, the plugin uses industry-standard encryption and authentication to protect your site. All publishing activity is logged for your reference.

Can I use a specific WordPress user as the author?

Yes, you can select any Administrator, Editor, or Author user account to be set as the author of published posts. This is configurable on your Mark AI account.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

When you uninstall the plugin, all data including the API key, plugin settings, and activity logs are completely deleted. Your Mark AI account is not affected and all posts created by the plugin are preserved.

Does this plugin work without a Mark AI account?

No, this plugin requires an active Mark AI subscription. It connects your WordPress site to your Mark AI workspace to enable direct publishing.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin itself is 100% free. You need an active Mark AI subscription to use it, and your subscription must have available integration slots.

Does it work with custom domains on WordPress.com?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with all WordPress sites using custom domains, including WordPress.com Business and eCommerce plans that support plugins.

I installed the plugin manually. How do I connect it to Mark AI?

Go to Mark AI Integrations, click the WordPress connector, and follow the connection flow. The plugin will automatically link to your Mark AI workspace.

  • Initial release
  • One-click publishing from Mark AI
  • Automated workflow support
  • Post type discovery endpoint
  • Template support – use existing posts as reference templates
  • Post structure analysis for Elementor and Gutenberg
  • Extended Elementor widget support
  • Activity logging
  • Featured image support
  • Category and tag management
